verdict.line: You lose if you contest trades in the first two levels before your sustain comes online; you win if you survive to Heartsteel and start forcing fights she can't escape.

brief.thesis: Camille's damage is front-loaded into two commitment windows — the empowered Q auto and the delayed W cone — both of which land hardest while her passive shield is up and before you have any tank items. Tahm Kench's answer is a slow-burn rhythm: Q chip damage builds stun stacks and heals him, E banks damage into a shield, and none of it matters until item timings catch up. The 54.2% win rate over 179 games and Tahm's solo-kill edge both say this resolves in your favor once you reach that point — the lane is even, not hard.

theirWindow.when: Right after she lands a basic attack
theirWindow.what: That auto just granted her Passive (Adaptive Defenses), a shield vs your damage type. Don't trade into it — back off a beat and let the shield window expire before you commit Q.

yourWindow.when: You're one Q away from 3 stacks
yourWindow.what: Q (Tongue Lash) applies a stack of An Acquired Taste on hit; at 3 stacks it stuns and consumes them instead of just slowing. Land that fourth Q to lock her down, then follow with your own autos or R (Devour) on yourself to no-sell whatever she throws back.

start.why: Runs 54.9% WR over 175 games and is the 74.8% pick here — the passive attack-damage block directly dulls her poke-heavy early autos while you wait out her shield windows.

boots.why: 50% WR, 65.8% pick, and the flat physical damage reduction per hit cuts directly into a kit built entirely around landing basic attacks (Q empowered auto, passive triggers).

core.why: The core health-stacking item that turns your passive's max-health damage scaling and your raw tankiness into the thing that wins this matchup after level 9.
Standard second component on the 54.5% WR path — keeps your stats scaling alongside Heartsteel's health gain.

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs off your Q-heavy trade pattern, adds max-health damage on top of your passive, and heals you every time you land a poke — exactly the war of attrition this matchup turns into.

summoners.why: 56.1% pick rate and 56% WR — Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills once you land a 3-stack Q stun, since Camille has no self-heal to outlast the burn.

playing.title: Throw Q on cooldown, not for damage
playing.detail: Q (Tongue Lash) comes back every 7-5.5s as you rank it. Use it to chip stacks of An Acquired Taste even in neutral trades — the stun at 3 stacks is the real payoff, not the initial hit.

playing.title: Never trade into her fresh passive shield
playing.detail: If she just auto'd you, Adaptive Defenses is up and blunting your damage type. Wait one GCD before committing your own trade.

playing.title: Bank E before her burst windows
playing.detail: Thick Skin passively stores damage taken while you're out of combat; pop the active right as her empowered Q or W cone lands so the stored damage converts into a shield at the moment it matters most.

playing.title: Punish her E cooldown
playing.detail: Hookshot is her only gap-close and reset tool at 16-12s cooldown. If she's just used it to engage, she has no escape — this is when you commit your own W (Abyssal Dive) to knock her up and extend the fight toward your stun.

playing.title: Use R reactively, not offensively
playing.detail: Devour has no base cooldown and can target yourself for a shield — hold it in reserve to swallow her all-in burst rather than spending it early for chip damage.

playing.title: Don't contest level 1-2 all-ins
playing.detail: Her empowered Q plus the outer half of her W cone outdamages anything you have before your sustain runes and items kick in. Play passive, take the Doran's Shield block damage, and wait.

playing.title: Force fights once Heartsteel completes
playing.detail: This is your real power spike — your health total makes every subsequent trade disproportionately favor you. Start initiating instead of waiting for her to commit.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the win-rate figures above are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning — when to trade, what to watch, how the cooldowns interact — is this brief's own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid fighting Camille when she has (P) active, while using [Q] before she closes in to deal damage. She is strong during early game, so try to fight her after purchasing items to tank her damage.
